newsitem.title: DUBAI: Quake kills 100, injures 250 in northern Iran.
newsitem.headline: Quake kills 100, injures 250 in northern Iran.

text.p: An earthquake killed at least 100 people and injured 250 in northwestern Iran on Friday, Iranian state television said.

"The country's Natural Disaster Headquarters announced, with regret, that at least 100 of our compatriots have lost their lives and over 250 people were injured," said the television, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.
The television said the earthquake, measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale, hit the city of Ardabil and the town of Meshkinshahr at 4.27 p.m. (1257 GMT).
The quake also caused considerable damage in many of the surrounding districts in Ardabil province which borders Azerbaijan, it said.
Rescue teams had rushed to the stricken areas, the television said.
The Iranian news agency IRNA earlier said earthquakes also shook neighbouring Gilan province and the city of Sanadaj in western Iran on Friday. It did not report any casualties in those quakes.
